test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five people A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only two people are seated to the left of C. D is sitting at the extreme right end. B is not an immediate neighbour of D, and is second to the left of A. Where is B sitting?

options.text: To the immediate right of E
To the immediate right of C
Fourth to the left of D
Third to the left of A

solution: Given: Five people A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a straight row, facing north. 1) Only two people are seated to the left of C. 2) D is sitting at the extreme right end.
